item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 19/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect southern China today. An upper-air disturbance will bring some showers to the region in the next couple of days. Under the influence of a southerly airstream, the weather is expected to be hot over Guangdong towards the weekend to early next week.

Date/Month: 19/04 (Tuesday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4.
Weather: Cloudy with one or two showers.
Temp range: 19 - 22 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
